bounds: evidence/n3-vulkan-raster-bounds.json (committed df6ca42 before any code or run)
ci: GitHub Actions run 38953936900, job vulkan-linux, ubuntu-24.04: lavapipe (llvmpipe, LLVM 20.1.2, Mesa 25.2.8, Vulkan 1.4.318), Xvfb at 1280 x 720 x 24, Weston headless (pixman) at 1280 x 720, the Khronos validation layer on (any error fails the run). Records: evidence/n3-lavapipe/*.json, each the program's own output.

v1_x11.result: pass: presented run 1, presented run 2 and the offscreen run, 600 of 600 equal

v2_wayland.result: pass: two presented runs on Weston, 600 of 600 equal to each other and to the offscreen run

v3_cross_api.result: pass: the lavapipe offscreen list and both Wayland lists equal the committed D3D12 WARP list (evidence/n2-warp/offscreen.json), 600 of 600. The same frames, hash for hash, on two APIs and three drivers (WARP, lavapipe, and SwiftShader for the 5 frames run locally).

v4_control.result: pass: with the blit offset (1, 0), 600 of 600 frames differ, so the gate fails as required

v5_lifecycle_x11.result: pass: 600 of 600 equal the offscreen run on the same size schedule; events in order: resized 256x144, resized 320x180, minimised (unmap), restored 320x180, device loss injected before frame 500, VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST at the next submission, recovered on a new device and swapchain 320x180. One loss, one recovery, no size mismatch.

v6_lifecycle_wayland.result: pass: 600 of 600 equal; the record says the minimise step was skipped because xdg-shell does not report it; one loss, one recovery

v7_fullscreen.result: pass on both: the swapchain reached 1280 x 720, three frames there equal offscreen frames of that size, and it returned to 320 x 180

v8_pacing_harness.result: pass for the harness only: 599 finite positive intervals. Xvfb has no vertical blank, so FIFO presents were not paced (median 0.76 ms) and no refresh period was known; no pacing claim is made.

local_swiftshader.result: pass: the selftest on Windows with SwiftShader and a Win32 surface, validation layer on: presented equals offscreen, control fails, fullscreen and the lifecycle run recover; the first 5 offscreen frames equal WARP's. HDR10 skipped: the surface offers only sRGB.

results.local_wsl: lavapipe in WSL Ubuntu 24.04 (nice 19): the X11 selftest on Xvfb and the Wayland lifecycle runs under WSLg passed before CI, and lavapipe's 600 offscreen frames equalled WARP's. CI is the record; these were development checks.

mistakes_found_on_the_way: The first validation-layer run failed: the PQ pass's storage buffer was at binding 0. glslang moves an HLSL RWStructuredBuffer with --shift-ssbo-binding; the --shift-UAV-binding flag first used does not apply to it. An earlier manual check of the SPIR-V had looked at the blit pass only. Fixed before any recorded run.
The Vulkan loader could not open the SwiftShader manifest in its Playwright folder; a copy in the scratch folder loads. Not a code issue.
does_not_prove: Behaviour on hardware Vulkan drivers, on a Steam Deck or under Proton; HDR10 through a Vulkan swapchain (not offered by these drivers); recovery from a driver's own device loss (the loss here is injected at the RHI); frame pacing on Linux.
